title: Dates & Time
description: The date bugs that reach production, and how to avoid them: a Date is one instant read through the machine's time zone, so store UTC and render in the viewer's zone; parse only ISO strings and format with Intl; keep birthdays and due dates as date-only values with their own arithmetic, because DST days aren't 24 hours; then when a library is worth it, and where Temporal stands.
